initial_context:
# Pull Request #142: Authentication and Token Refresh

Adds JWT refresh token rotation and Redis token blacklist.

steps.content:
## Vulnerability Audit Finding

Identified CWE-384: Session Fixation risk in /auth/refresh endpoint. In-memory token expiration window is 300 seconds without sliding invalidation. Recommends enforcing nonce validation on redis key uth:blacklist:{token_id}.

## Architecture and Storage Revision

Redesigned token blacklist storage to use Redis pipeline with atomic SETEX and 300s TTL. Updated signature verification in erify_token_header() to reject unverified nonces.

## Test Automation and Invariants

Authored 8 concurrency tests validating replay protection under 50 simultaneous refresh calls. Confirmed zero race conditions and 100% rejection of recycled tokens.
